name: Ha Giang
provinceNote: The former Hà Giang province is in Tuyên Quang after Resolution 202/2025/QH15. The loop and the town are still called Ha Giang.
summary: A mountain province in Vietnam’s far north, famous for a four-day road loop over high passes. Ride past the Quan Ba twin hills and Dong Van’s stone old town to the Ma Pi Leng pass above the Nho Que River, with Sunday markets and buckwheat flowers in autumn. Best for adventurous riders with four days to spare.
fee: No single loop ticket. Border-area permit: Check on arrival. Palace (commune article): 7:30–17:00 every day; about 20,000 đồng adult; free under 1.2 m — Check on arrival. Walking the Đồng Văn old quarter: no ticket on the UNESCO page. Pass fees, Lũng Cú, Đồn Cao, Happiness Road, Lùng Tám, Hoàng Su Phì, the Nho Quế boat, and gathering fees: Check on arrival.
getThere: Road only from Hà Nội, about 300 km. Adventures page: about six hours. Place page: about six to seven hours by car or sleeper bus. Buses leave Bến xe Mỹ Đình by day and overnight. Fare: Check on arrival. Rail: Check on arrival. License class: Check on arrival. Pass (UNESCO): 1,200 m. Former city seat (GeoNames): about 107 m on SRTM3; about 115 m on ASTER. Mèo Vạc is 24 km from Đồng Văn. Palace: about 14 km from Đồng Văn town (loop page); about 15 km from the center of xã Đồng Văn (commune article). Building more than 1,200 m² on a site of about 3,000 m², and the whole residence also given as about 3,000 m². Palace dates: work began 1898 and finished 1907 (commune article); built 1902 (place page); nearly 100 years ago (loop page). Lũng Cú: a three-hour detour, 200 steps. Happiness Road: 1,300 volunteers and seven years (adventures page); begun in the late 1950s and over seven years, with no volunteer count (buckwheat feature). Sky path: 500 m, about two hours. Tu Sản canyon: 700–800 m and one of Southeast Asia’s deepest (UNESCO); 800-metre cliffs and the deepest gorge in Southeast Asia (culture page). Ethnic groups: 17 (UNESCO); 19 (loop page). Geopark office: Số 2A, đường Bạch Đằng, phường Hà Giang 1, tỉnh Tuyên Quang. Which 2026 commune holds the twin hills: Check on arrival. Minutes from the loop to Hoàng Su Phì, visit lengths, the market hour, the Phố Cáo weekday, the Khau Vai 2026 civil date, the buckwheat festival’s 2026 day, the Tày fish festival day at Mậu Duệ, the boat time, and a closure on a given day: Check on arrival.
bestMonths: September to November, plus the other flower windows
seoTitle: Ha Giang travel guide — the loop, Ma Pi Leng, Quan Ba, Dong Van
seoDescription: Ride the loop past the Quan Ba twin hills and Dong Van’s stone town to Ma Pi Leng above the Nho Que. Sunday markets, buckwheat in autumn, and four days on the road from Hanoi.
intro: You look up at the Quản Bạ twin hills, two rounded hills over the terraces, with karst in the cloud. The loop runs on through Yên Minh, Đồng Văn, and Mèo Vạc. Mã Pì Lèng is the high road above the Nho Quế.

Give the loop four days. The road follows QL4C northeast from the town to Bảo Lâm, and QL34 southwest back. Mèo Vạc is 24 km from Đồng Văn and takes most of a morning if you stop. Experienced drivers can rent a motorcycle in town, ride behind a local rider, or take a private car. Do not ride alone. Take a local driver. Ride in daylight and stop after dark.

Breakfast in town, on the morning you ride toward Đồng Văn, is phở. In Đồng Văn, bánh cuốn is the breakfast on Phố Cổ. The highland pots are thắng cố, mèn mén, and cháo ấu tẩu. Thắng cố may be horse, buffalo, beef, or pork. Sunday fills the markets at Đồng Văn and Mèo Vạc. The evening in Đồng Văn is that market, at night or early morning. In town, the night is sleep before an early start.

Sà Phìn is the food and fuel stop before Đồng Văn. The Hmong palace there is green stone, po mu wood, and terracotta, carved with dragon, phoenix, and bat, with three courtyards and a stone bath for Vương Chính Đức. The frame is wood. The style is given as Chinese, and also as Chinese, French, and Hmong. It has been a national architectural relic since 1993, and the building cost named for it is about 150,000 Indochinese silver đồng. Lũng Cú is a three-hour detour, 200 steps, in the late afternoon. On the way back you sleep in Bảo Lâm and eat at the stalls in Bắc Mê. Du Già in June is a twin-stream fall and a swim. Hoàng Su Phì in June is flooded terraces, the mirror of the sky, farmed by Dao, Nùng, and La Chí. September is a different window, golden rice.
gettingAround: Day buses and sleeper buses leave Bến xe Mỹ Đình in Hà Nội. The highlands are road only. Fuel and meals are in the small towns. Start in daylight.

stayAreas.name: Dong Van
stayAreas.summary: The overnight on the high plateau, in the stone town before the pass. The four-day road stays overnight here. Yên Minh is the first night on that road, Mèo Vạc is the town after the pass, Bảo Lâm is the return night, and the bus night is in Hà Giang town.

eat: Breakfast in town is phở, before the ride toward Đồng Văn. In Đồng Văn, breakfast is bánh cuốn on Phố Cổ. The highland table is thắng cố, mèn mén, cháo ấu tẩu, and the other dishes named for the plateau. Sunday is the market at Đồng Văn and Mèo Vạc.
interestsBody: Dining is phở before the ride, bánh cuốn on Phố Cổ, and the highland pots.
The loop is QL4C and QL34: Quản Bạ’s twin hills, Đồng Văn’s old quarter, and Mã Pì Lèng above the Nho Quế. Sunday is the market. The palace at Sà Phìn is the history stop.

blocks.heading: Sunday markets
paragraphs: Sunday is the market in Đồng Văn and Mèo Vạc. People from the villages trade, at night or early morning in the old quarter. Ask your host when the stalls fill, because the timetables are hard to pin.

Phố Cáo meets once a week for household goods, clothes, and spices, with Flower Hmong skirts and Black Hmong tunics. It now sits inside xã Phố Bảng. Lùng Tám, in the foothills still called Quản Bạ, is hemp spun, dyed, and woven, with a shop next door.

interestGroups.title: The loop
interestGroups.summary: The four-day road through Quản Bạ, Yên Minh, Đồng Văn, and Mèo Vạc.

blocks.heading: The high road
paragraphs: QL4C leaves the town toward Quản Bạ. Heaven’s Gate is the pass lookout over the winding road, mist, and valleys. Cafe Cổng Trời is the veranda coffee on that pass. Tam Sơn, now in xã Quản Bạ, is lunch: northern fare at the stalls, and coffee. The overnight that day is Yên Minh, not Tam Sơn. Pine forest stands beside QL4C. Dốc Chín Khoanh, between Yên Minh and Sà Phìn, is the curved road into the valley. Stop off the curve.
Mã Pì Lèng is the rim between Đồng Văn and Mèo Vạc, in Mèo Vạc. The canyon below is Tu Sản. Side road 193A drops closer to the river. A boat or a kayak is named for June, when the river is full.

The sky path above the Nho Quế is a steep walk of 500 metres, about two hours, through Flower Hmong villages. The return on QL34 sleeps in Bảo Lâm and eats at the stalls in Bắc Mê. That valley is not Mã Pì Lèng.

blocks.heading: Quan Ba and the terraces
paragraphs: Núi đôi Quản Bạ are the two rounded hills above the terraces. The caption on the photograph is Núi đôi Quảng Bạ. The hills, the terraces, and the karst in cloud are the picture of this loop. Xã Quản Bạ joins thị trấn Tam Sơn, xã Quyết Tiến, and xã Quản Bạ. Xã Cán Tỷ joins Bát Đại Sơn and Cán Tỷ.
Hoàng Su Phì is a different valley. In June the terraces are flooded, farmed by Dao, Nùng, and La Chí. September golden rice is another window.

blocks.heading: Dong Van
paragraphs: Đồng Văn is the stone town. About 40 houses from 1890, a market and houses together. Walk the old quarter. Use the market at night or early morning. Sunday is the market day in Đồng Văn and Mèo Vạc. Arrive before sunset. The pass and the old quarter are not the same hour.

Đồn Cao is a 20-minute hike up from Đồng Văn for the view. Go in daylight. Mèo Vạc, 24 km over the pass, is lunch and, on some routes, a night. Sunday is its market too. Xã Đồng Văn and xã Mèo Vạc are the 2025 communes. Older pages still say the towns.

blocks.heading: The Hmong palace
paragraphs: Dinh thự họ Vương, also called Dinh vua Mèo, stands in thôn Sà Phìn, xã Sà Phìn. The building is green stone, po mu wood, and terracotta, carved with dragon, phoenix, and bat. Vương Chính Đức’s house has three courtyards and a stone bath. The frame is wood. The style is given as Chinese, and also as Chinese, French, and Hmong.
It is a national architectural relic from 1993. The building cost named for it is about 150,000 Indochinese silver đồng. Go in daylight.

blocks.heading: Sunday markets
paragraphs: Sunday is the market in Đồng Văn and Mèo Vạc. Khau Vai love market is in the spring, with the March flowers, on the Mèo Vạc side. The buckwheat festival is typically mid-to-late November in Đồng Văn district, with cultural displays, crafts, buckwheat food, a road race, and kayak and paddle-board racing on the Nho Quế. The Tày fish festival at xã Mậu Duệ is named for 2026.

faqs.q: How long does the bus from Hanoi take?
faqs.a: Allow a morning or a night. The published rides are about six hours, and about six to seven hours by car or sleeper bus. The road is about 300 km, and it is the only way in. Day buses and sleeper buses leave Bến xe Mỹ Đình.

faqs.q: Can you ride the loop yourself?
faqs.a: Experienced drivers can rent a motorcycle in town, ride behind a local rider, or take a private car. Do not ride alone. Take a local driver. Ride in daylight and stop after dark.

The bus night is in Hà Giang town, now phường Hà Giang 1 and phường Hà Giang 2. Older pages still say thành phố Hà Giang. On the four-day road the first night on the plateau is Yên Minh, then Đồng Văn, and the return night is Bảo Lâm. Mèo Vạc is the town after the pass. Thôn Tha, a few minutes outside the city, is a stilt-house night with a family meal of spring rolls, greens, pork ribs, and rice.

faqs.q: When is buckwheat, and when are the markets?
faqs.a: September to November is the marked window: golden rice in September, buckwheat from October to November. Khau Vai love market is in the spring with the March flowers. The buckwheat festival is typically mid-to-late November in Đồng Văn district. Sunday is market day in Đồng Văn and Mèo Vạc. The Tày fish festival at Mậu Duệ is named for 2026. Ask your host for the day.

faqs.q: Do you need a border permit?
faqs.a: The old province is a Frontier Area. Ask about the permit, the fee, the processing time, and which communes sit inside the border zone before you ride.

faqs.q: Is Ha Giang still a province?
faqs.a: The former Hà Giang province is in Tuyên Quang. Resolution 202/2025/QH15 was signed in Hà Nội on 12 June 2025 and took force that day. New provincial governments date from 1 July 2025. The new province is 13,795.50 km² and 1,865,270 people, bordering Cao Bằng, Lào Cai, Phú Thọ, Thái Nguyên, and China. Those figures are the province, not the town. The loop and the town are still called Ha Giang.

season.label: September to November
season.note: September to November: terraced rice turns golden in September, buckwheat blooms from October to November, the climate is cool, winters are cold, and roads are wet and slippery from May to August. Also October to December for purple buckwheat, canola, and mustard; February to March for spring flowers; September and October for golden rice; March flowers including cherry, plum, mustard, and pear; and summer terraces full of water. Buckwheat from October to November, and peach and plum blossoms from January to February. White blooms in late September, pink as October slides into November, deep red by the end of December, and a festival typically in mid-to-late November. June is the month for flooded fields at Hoàng Su Phì and a swim at Du Già.
